oil.when: 2022–2023 new-generation Grand Cherokee, Grand Cherokee L and 4xe (not the older-style 2022 Grand Cherokee WK)
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed.
Keep your foot off the brake and press ENGINE START/STOP until the cluster shows ON/RUN with the engine not running. On many models the first press is ACC and the second is ON/RUN.
Press the down arrow on the steering wheel until the cluster shows Vehicle Info.
Press the right arrow until the Oil Life screen shows.
Press and hold OK until the oil life reads 100%. If a message says the engine must be off with the ignition in run, switch the engine off and try again.
Press the up or down arrow to leave the menu.
oil.note: Backup method from the same sources: ignition in ON/RUN with the engine off, slowly push the accelerator fully to the floor three times within 10 seconds, then switch off without touching the brake. If the oil message is back at the next start, the reset did not take; repeat it.

steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed.
Keep your foot off the brake and press ENGINE START/STOP twice (first press ACC, second press ON/RUN). Do not start the engine.
Use the steering wheel arrow buttons to go to Vehicle Info in the cluster display, then to the Oil Life screen.
Press and hold OK until the oil life gauge goes back to 100%.
Start the vehicle. If the oil change message comes back, the reset did not take; repeat it or use the pedal method.
oil.note: The 2017 manual also gives the accelerator pedal method (ignition on, engine off, pedal fully down slowly three times within 10 seconds, then ignition off).

steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed.
Keep your foot off the brake and press ENGINE START/STOP twice (first press ACC, second press ON/RUN). Do not start the engine.
Slowly push the accelerator pedal all the way to the floor and let it up, three times, all within 10 seconds.
Keep your foot off the brake and press ENGINE START/STOP once more to switch the ignition off.
Start the vehicle. If the oil change message shows again, the reset did not take, so repeat the steps.
oil.note: Checked in the 2015 and 2017 owner's manuals, which both give this pedal method.

tpms.when: 2015–2017 Grand Cherokee (no reset button; the light clears itself)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the sticker in the driver's door opening. The spare has no sensor.
If you are filling tires that are already warm, you may need up to about 4 psi more than the sticker to turn the light off; recheck them cold later.
Drive normally. The system can take up to 20 minutes above 15 mph to read the new pressures.
The light goes out by itself once every tire is at or above the sticker pressure.
tpms.note: Checked in the 2015 and 2017 owner's manuals: neither has a driver reset, and the system updates itself (the drive-time figure is from the 2017 manual). If the light flashes for about 75 seconds and then stays on, with a SERVICE TPM SYSTEM message, the system has a fault that adding air will not clear; have it checked. The light also stays on while the spare is fitted.
